### Caesars Entertainment Expands Remote Gameplay Portfolio with Launch of Remote Roulette™ Inside Tropicana Atlantic City


09/21/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 464 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/Caesars-Entertainment-Expands-Remote-Gameplay-Portfolio-with-Launch-of-Remote-Roulette-Inside-Tropicana-Atlantic-City-2026-U8S5b3e7Js-2026.pdf)


*New offering brings online and brick-and-mortar players together at the same live roulette table from a Caesars Rewards® destination in real time*


**ATLANTIC CITY, N.J. (Sept. 21, 2026)** – Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR) ("Caesars") today announced the launch of *Remote Roulette™* , powered by Evolution’s Dual Play Roulette **,** a new gaming experience that allows online players in New Jersey to participate in roulette gameplay streamed live from the casino floor at Tropicana Atlantic City. Available on Caesars Palace Online Casino, *Remote Roulette* enables online players and casino guests to place bets on the same roulette table and share game outcomes in real time.


As the latest addition to Caesars' remote gameplay portfolio, *Remote Roulette* extends casino-floor gameplay beyond the property and gives online players another way to participate in live casino action from a Caesars Rewards destination. Every spin takes place on a physical roulette table located on the Tropicana Atlantic City casino floor, bringing online players directly into the action from anywhere in New Jersey.


“ *Remote Roulette* brings online players closer to the casino floor than ever before,” said Matthew Sunderland, Senior Vice President and Chief iGaming Officer at Caesars Digital. “Whether you're standing at the table inside Tropicana Atlantic City or playing from your phone in New Jersey through Caesars Palace Online Casino, you're participating in the same game. That's a unique experience that reflects the new ways we're connecting our destinations and digital platforms.”


“Our partnership with Caesars has always been built around finding new ways to bring great experiences to players,” said Marcus Huber, Chief Commercial Officer at Evolution. **** “Remote Roulette is another example of what we can achieve together, combining Caesars’ iconic casino experience with Evolution’s Dual Play Roulette to connect the physical and online experience in a new way. We’re proud to continue building on our partnership and look forward to what we can create together next.”


Unlike traditional online roulette products, *Remote Roulette* allows online and in-person players to participate in the same game through a physical roulette table located on the casino floor, with every spin and outcome shared in real time. The experience combines the authenticity of on-property roulette with the convenience of online play.


*Remote Roulette* joins[Remote Reels](https://newsroom.caesars.com/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Caesars-Entertainment-Celebrates-the-Launch-of-Remote-Reels-Delivering-an-Unmatched-Casino-Floor-Experience-to-Caesars-Palace-Online-Casino-Players/default.aspx) *™* at Tropicana Atlantic City as part of Caesars' growing suite of remote gameplay experiences that bring casino-floor action directly to online players. Available within the Live Casino section of Caesars Palace Online Casino, the offering reflects Caesars' continued efforts to connect its destination experiences with its digital gaming platforms.


Caesars Entertainment is an industry leader in Responsible Gaming, known for pioneering Responsible Gaming awareness and education. In 1989, Caesars became the first commercial casino company to address problem gambling by launching the industry's first Responsible Gaming program, Project 21. Today, the Company's commitment to ensuring all players are aware of Responsible Gaming resources remains steadfast and spans all of Caesars' digital platforms and world-class destinations in which it operates. Through personalized emails, push notifications and in-app messaging, Caesars helps connect players with Responsible Gaming resources, educational content and tools based on their engagement with the Company's online platforms. Caesars Entertainment proudly enforces an enhanced 21+ gaming policy that prevents individuals under the age of 21 from using Caesars Rewards and restricts access to its gaming products for individuals under the age of 21. For more information about Caesars Entertainment's Responsible Gaming program, please visit[https://www.caesars.com/corporate](https://www.caesars.com/corporate) .
